candidates.description: This feature vector represents numeric digits and characters from the Devanagari script.
This feature vector represents subword tokens and fragments characteristic of the Hindi script and Devanagari orthography.
This vector activates for characters and common words in the Devanagari script.
These tokens represent Hindi vowel matras (dependent vowel signs) combined with punctuation marks.
These tokens represent common conjunct consonants and characters in the Devanagari script used for writing Hindi and other Indian languages.
This vector represents Devanagari script characters and common sub-word components used in Hindi text.
This vector represents Hindi vocabulary tokens, predominantly starting with the vowel 'आ' (ā).
These tokens represent fragments of text written in the Devanagari script, predominantly featuring the consonant 'द' (da) combined with various vowel signs.
This vector represents common suffixes, inflections, and root components associated with verbs in the Hindi language.
This vector activates strongly for common subword tokens and fragments in Indo-Aryan languages like Hindi.
